_doc: OID data-source status config (Jeffrey 2026-10-10). Read by dashboard/source_status.py every 5 min RTH / hourly otherwise and on every publish. Edit text fields freely. 'static' rows are not checked (status shown as configured: 'Needs purchase' or 'Missing'). 'known_missing': true = accepted gap that does not alarm until the row has been Live at least once (then a drop is a regression). Signal fields: path | glob (newest match) | proc (pgrep -f pattern) | exists; cadence: always (daemon heartbeat, any hour) | intraday (TTL in RTH, prior-close carry otherwise) | daily | event; ttl_s; required (default true); max_sessions (daily/event); due_et (daily: ET time on each trading day by which that day's write is expected), max_sessions (daily: how many trading days old is still OK).
